captions.detailed: This 3D model is a C-shaped stopper clamp designed to grip a cylindrical pole. It features an outer curved channel or groove running along its lower perimeter to guide a rope, and several vertical slots along its body to allow the plastic to flex under tightening tension. The inner surface has a recessed section designed to accommodate a rubber sheet for enhanced friction against the pole.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric stopper clamp in OpenSCAD that can grip a pole using a self-tightening rope loop. The model must allow adjustments for pole diameter, rubber insert thickness, main part height, rope hole diameter, and the number of flexing cuts along the outer shell.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main 'unflexing' module combined with boolean operations. The 'unflexing' module uses a hull operation of a custom chamfered cylinder (bcylinder) and a custom elongated torus (elongorus) to form the main body, from which the inner pole cylinder, rubber sheet recess, and rope channel are subtracted. The main assembly then applies a scaled cube to create a wide opening angle, a loop to subtract vertical flexing cuts using hull-cylinder operations, and subtracts beveled entry holes for the rope.
